title: Beltrame Costabili, governor of the see of Esztergom, to Eleonora d'Aragona and Ercole I d'Este: ten partly ciphered despatches
correspondents: Beltrame Costabili → Eleonora d'Aragona, Duchess of Ferrara (1491–92); → Ercole I d'Este (1493)
shelfmark: Modena, Archivio di Stato, Ambasciatori Ungheria b. 2/20 nos. 6, 7, 12, 16, 44; b. 2/21 no. 8; b. 2/22 nos. 5, 6, 9 (DECODE R1162–R1168, R1095–R1097)
status: Cryptoole HU1492-2 (DECODE 'Partially decrypted', 10 records). DECODE: Italian clear text with cipher passages, 'homophonic or simple substitution', graphic signs; images need a login and DECODE notes Vestigia (vestigia.hu) holds related items. research/oldest/CANDIDATES.md B2 lists these letters but they were not checked (only Sadoleto 1482–83 was, in targets/sadoleto1482/). Whether 'partially decrypted' means interlinear or filed contemporary decipherments, as it did for Sadoleto, is not known.
why: Ferrara's man at the Hungarian court during the succession crisis after Matthias Corvinus's death (1490–91), the fate of Queen Beatrice of Aragon, Eleonora's sister, and Ippolito d'Este's Esztergom archbishopric.
verify: Log in to DECODE and download R1162–R1168 and R1095–R1097. Check each leaf for interlinear or filed decipherments as in the Sadoleto series. Search Vestigia for 'Costabili' clear copies. Then test the Ferrarese Hungary keys from targets/sadoleto1482/ (key_working.md) against the unread passages.

correspondents: William Craven, 1st Baron Craven → Prince Rupert

status: Cryptoole XX1648-1 (open). correspondents: Miguel Fernández Durán (Secretario del Despacho de Guerra) → Vicente Bacallar y Sanna, marqués de San Felipe (Spanish envoy at Genoa)
shelfmark: Barcelona, Archivo de la Corona de Aragón, Diversos, Legación en Génova y Turín, Cajón 1, leg. 22, doc. 67 (DECODE R10181)
status: Cryptoole XX1718-2 (open). DECODE R10181 'Non-decrypted', public access (not public domain). About 309 tokens, 148 distinct (Turner's transcription).
